name: hydrogen-agent
description: Let coding agents drive your logged-in Hydrogen browser over the Chrome DevTools Protocol: a CLI, an MCP server and a JS REPL.

scripts.bundle: esbuild bin/hydrogen.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/hydrogen.mjs --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --log-level=warning "--banner:js=import { createRequire as createRequireForBundle } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequireForBundle(import.meta.url);"
